Now, around now, or already arranged: AM: Ahora, estos días o algo ya acordado: AM / IS / ARE + VERB-ING.
\"It's all arranged\" = a fixed plan: AM: "It's all arranged" = un plan fijo: AM + VERB-ING.
An annoying habit: IS + ALWAYS + VERB-IN: Un hábito molesto: IS + ALWAYS + VERB-ING.
\"right now\" in a question: ARE + you +: "right now" en una pregunta: ARE + you + VERB-ING?
IS + GETTING: a change that is happening: IS + GETTING: un cambio que está ocurriendo ahora. Present continuous.
\"this week\" = for now, not for ever: I: "this week" = por ahora, no para siempre: IS + VERB-ING.
\"Right now\" = in the middle of it: ARE: "Right now" = en plena acción: ARE + COOKING.
No está pasando ahora: AM + NOT + VERB-ING. Mantén tanto AM como -ING.
Good. Packs on. We **are leaving** the l: Bien. Mochilas a la espalda. Ya **nos vamos** del lago.

Facts, habits and timetables: VERB, or V: Hechos, hábitos y horarios: VERB, o VERB + -S / -ES después de he / she / it. Preguntas y negativas: DO / DOES.
Un hábito, y Momo es "he": VERB + -S.
A fact about the world, and water is \"i: Un hecho sobre el mundo, y el agua es "it": VERB + -S. Sin IS.
\"On every climb\" = a habit, one thing: "On every climb" = un hábito, una cosa tras otra. Una sola persona, y WATCH termina en -CH: VERB + -ES.
\"usually\" = a habit. A question with \: "usually" = un hábito. Pregunta con "you": DO + you + BASE VERB?
ISN'T + WORKING with \"today\": a proble: ISN'T + WORKING con "today": un problema de ahora, no un hecho sobre la radio. Present continuous.
Un horario: la hora la fijó otra persona. VERB + -S.
A habit, negative, with \"I\": DON'T + B: Un hábito, en negativa, con "I": DON'T + BASE VERB.
NEVER is already negative: NEVER + VERB: NEVER ya es negativo: NEVER + VERB + -S, sin DOESN'T.
Tensing **wakes** everyone at five. The: Tensing nos **despierta** a todos a las cinco. El sendero **empieza** detrás de la roca grande.
Camp three. We **left** the river at sev: Campamento tres. **Dejamos** el río a las siete y **caminamos** todo el día.
I **saw** an eagle! It **flew** right ov: ¡**Vi** un águila! **Pasó volando** justo por encima de nosotros.
Finished, at a time that is stated or cl: Terminado, en un momento que se dice o está claro: PAST FORM (-ED, o la forma irregular). Preguntas y negativas: DID + BASE VERB.
\"In 1998\" = a finished, stated time: P: "In 1998" = un tiempo terminado y especificado: PAST FORM, -ED.
\"at four o'clock\" = a stated time. GET: "at four o'clock" = una hora concreta. GET es irregular: GOT.
\"yesterday\" = finished time. BREAK is: "yesterday" = tiempo terminado. BREAK es irregular: BROKE.
\"before we left\" = finished time: DID: "before we left" = tiempo terminado: DID + you + BASE VERB? Con una forma de pasado basta.
ARE + ACHING: happening now, even with \: ARE + ACHING: está pasando ahora, aunque en la frase aparezca "yesterday". Present continuous, no el campamento tres.
\"last night\", negative: DIDN'T + BASE: "last night", en negativa: DIDN'T + BASE VERB. Nunca DIDN'T + SLEPT.
STOP → STOPPED: one syllable ending in o: STOP → STOPPED: una sílaba que termina en una vocal + una consonante, así que se dobla la última letra antes de -ED.
\"we\" + BE in the past: WERE. Not WAS,: "we" + BE en pasado: WERE. No WAS, y nunca DID BE.
I **walked** fourteen kilometres, and I: ¡**Caminé** catorce kilómetros y **no me quejé** ni una vez!
Camp four. We**'ve climbed** twelve hund: Campamento cuatro. **Hemos subido** mil doscientos metros desde el lago.
A past with a line to now, and no finish: Un pasado unido al ahora, sin especificar un tiempo terminado: HAVE / HAS + PAST PARTICIPLE.
All your life up to now: HAVE + NEVER +: Toda tu vida hasta ahora: HAVE + NEVER + PAST PARTICIPLE. BE → BEEN.
Moments ago, and still hot: HAVE + JUST: Hace un momento, y aún caliente: HAVE + JUST + PAST PARTICIPLE. MAKE → MADE.
\"since Tuesday\" = from then up to now:: "since Tuesday" = desde entonces hasta ahora: HAVE + BEEN.
\"ever\" = at any time up to now: HAVE +: "ever" = alguna vez hasta ahora: HAVE + you + PAST PARTICIPLE? RIDE → RIDDEN.
LEFT with \"on Tuesday\": a finished, st: LEFT con "on Tuesday": un tiempo terminado y especificado. Past simple, no el campamento cuatro.
He is there now and not back yet: HAS GO: Ahora está allí y aún no ha vuelto: HAS GONE. HAS BEEN significaría que fue y volvió.
\"for twenty years\" and still true: HAV: "for twenty years" y sigue siendo verdad: HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE. KNOW → KNOWN.
\"two years ago\" = a finished, stated t: "two years ago" = un tiempo terminado y especificado: PAST FORM, que te devuelve al campamento tres. BUILD → BUILT.
We**'ve done** the easy part. From here: Ya **hemos hecho** la parte fácil. A partir de aquí, el sendero se empina.
Here's the plan. Tomorrow we**'re going: Este es el plan. Mañana **vamos a cruzar** el prado, y luego **vamos a subir** la cresta.
Look at those clouds. It**'s going to ra: Mirad esas nubes. Esta noche **va a llover**.
A plan already made, or a future you can: Un plan ya hecho, o un futuro que ves venir: AM / IS / ARE + GOING TO + BASE VERB. Un plan que no se cumplió: WAS / WERE GOING TO.
She can see it coming: IS + GOING TO + B: Lo ve venir: IS + GOING TO + BASE VERB. Mantén IS, y mantén TO.
A decision already made: ARE + GOING TO: Una decisión ya tomada: ARE + GOING TO + BASE VERB. Sin -ING después de TO.
\"I\" + a plan you have prepared for: AM: "I" + un plan para el que te has preparado: AM + GOING TO + BASE VERB.
A question about what is coming: ARE + w: Una pregunta sobre lo que viene: ARE + we + GOING TO + BASE VERB? No DO.
WILL + BE after \"I'm sure\": an opinion: WILL + BE después de "I'm sure": una opinión sobre el futuro. Future simple, no going to.
A plan not to do it: AREN'T + GOING TO +: Un plan de no hacerlo: AREN'T + GOING TO + BASE VERB. No DON'T.
A plan already made: IS + GOING TO + PHO: Un plan ya hecho: IS + GOING TO + PHONE.
A plan that did not happen: WAS + GOING: Un plan que no se cumplió: WAS + GOING TO, y luego "but".
Rest now. Tomorrow **is going to be** a: Descansad. Mañana **va a ser** un día largo.
What a day! We **were crossing** the rid: ¡Vaya día! **Estábamos cruzando** la cresta cuando llegó la tormenta.
I **was holding** the rope so tightly th: **Estaba agarrando** la cuerda con tanta fuerza que me **temblaban** las manos.
The background, or an action in progress: El contexto, o una acción en curso cuando pasó algo: WAS / WERE + VERB-ING.
In the middle of it, then cut off: WAS +: En plena acción, y luego interrumpida: WAS + VERB-ING ... WHEN + PAST FORM.
\"At three o'clock\" = in the middle of: "At three o'clock" = en plena acción. "we" lleva WERE + VERB-ING.
The long action, cut by a short one: WER: La acción larga, cortada por una corta: WERE + VERB-ING ... WHEN + PAST FORM.
Not in the middle of listening at that m: No estaba escuchando en ese momento: WASN'T + VERB-ING.
FELL: the short event that cut in. Past: FELL: el hecho corto que interrumpe. Past simple. WAS TAKING es el contexto.
\"you\" + an action already in progress:: "you" + una acción ya en curso: WERE + you + VERB-ING?
\"ate the rest cold\" = it was not finis: "ate the rest cold" = no se terminó: WERE + VERB-ING ... WHEN + PAST FORM.
KNOW is a state verb: no -ING. DIDN'T +: KNOW es un verbo de estado: sin -ING. DIDN'T + BASE VERB.
That night the stars **were shining** an: Esa noche las estrellas **brillaban** y Otto **cantaba** en su tienda.
Nobody knows what the weather **will do*: Nadie sabe qué **hará** el tiempo aquí arriba.
Quédate cerca de mí y **estarás** bien.
Decided now, offered, promised, or just: Decidido en el momento, ofrecido, prometido o simplemente lo que piensas: WILL + BASE VERB. Ofrecimientos en pregunta: SHALL I ...? Después de WHEN e IF: el presente.
An offer, decided as you speak: WILL ('L: Un ofrecimiento decidido mientras hablas: WILL ('LL) + BASE VERB. Sin TO después de WILL.
\"I think\" + your opinion of the future: "I think" + tu opinión sobre el futuro: WILL + BASE VERB. Sin -S después de WILL.
A promise: WON'T (= WILL NOT) + BASE VER: Una promesa: WON'T (= WILL NOT) + BASE VERB.
Offering to do something: SHALL + I + BA: Para ofrecerte a hacer algo: SHALL + I + BASE VERB?
IS GOING TO + FALL: you can see it comin: IS GOING TO + FALL: lo ves venir. Going to, no el campamento siete.
After WHEN, the future takes the present: Después de WHEN, el futuro va en presente: WHEN you ARRIVE, no WHEN you WILL ARRIVE.
Something that refuses to work: WON'T +: Algo que se niega a funcionar: WON'T + BASE VERB.
A question about the future: WILL + subj: Una pregunta sobre el futuro: WILL + sujeto + BASE VERB?
The clouds are building. We**'ll see** w: Las nubes se van acumulando. **Veremos** qué trae la mañana.
Look at the tracks behind us. We**'ve be: Mirad las huellas detrás de nosotros. **Hemos estado subiendo** desde el amanecer.
How long, up to now, or an activity that: Cuánto tiempo, hasta ahora, o una actividad que explica lo que ves ahora: HAVE / HAS + BEEN + VERB-ING.
\"since six this morning\", up to now: H: "since six this morning", hasta ahora: HAVE + BEEN + VERB-ING. No ARE + VERB-ING.
Black hands now are the evidence: HAVE +: Las manos negras de ahora son la prueba: HAVE + you + BEEN + VERB-ING?
\"since lunchtime\", up to now: HAS + BE: "since lunchtime", hasta ahora: HAS + BEEN + SNOWING.
KNOW is a state verb, so no -ING: HAVE +: KNOW es un verbo de estado, así que sin -ING: HAVE + you + KNOWN. Eso es el campamento cuatro, no el ocho.
HAS + STOPPED: un resultado que se ve ahora. Present perfect, no el campamento ocho.
\"three cups\" is a number, a result: HA: "three cups" es una cantidad, un resultado: HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE (campamento cuatro). DRINK → DRUNK.
An activity that has gone on up to now:: Una actividad que ha continuado hasta ahora: HAS + BEEN + SINGING.
\"lately\", up to now, negative: HAVEN'T: "lately", hasta ahora, en negativa: HAVEN'T + BEEN + VERB-ING.
Tomorrow morning we**'ll be crossing** t: Mañana por la mañana **estaremos cruzando** el glaciar.
And I**'ll be drinking** coffee in the s: Y yo **estaré tomando** café al sol. Cambio.
In progress at a time in the future, alr: En curso en un momento del futuro, ya previsto en el plan, o una suposición sobre ahora: WILL BE + VERB-ING.
\"At six tomorrow morning\" = in the mid: "At six tomorrow morning" = en plena acción a esa hora: WILL BE + VERB-ING.
A polite way to ask about plans: WILL +: Una forma educada de preguntar por los planes: WILL + you + BE + VERB-ING?
\"This time tomorrow\" = in the middle o: "This time tomorrow" = en plena acción en ese momento: WILL BE + BLOWING.
A confident guess about now: WILL ('LL): Una suposición segura sobre ahora: WILL ('LL) BE + VERB-ING.
WILL BE + STANDING: in progress at a fut: WILL BE + STANDING: en curso en un momento futuro. Future continuous.
KNOW is a state verb: plain WILL + KNOW,: KNOW es un verbo de estado: WILL + KNOW, sin más; nunca WILL BE KNOWING.
\"At midnight tonight\" = in the middle: "At midnight tonight" = en plena acción en ese momento: WILL BE + SLEEPING.
Not in progress at that future time: WON: Algo que no estará en curso en ese momento futuro: WON'T BE + VERB-ING.
Early night, everyone. At four tomorrow: Todos a dormir temprano. Mañana a las cuatro **estaremos caminando** sobre hielo.
When we got here, another team **had** a: Cuando llegamos, otro equipo ya **había tallado** escalones en el hielo. Mirad: podemos usarlos.
Before this trip I **had never been** ab: Antes de este viaje **nunca había estado** por encima de los cuatro mil metros.
The earlier of two past events, seen fro: El anterior de dos hechos pasados, visto desde el posterior, o un pasado que no ocurrió (IF ...): HAD + PAST PARTICIPLE.
\"By the time we reached\" is the later: "By the time we reached" es el pasado posterior. Aún antes: HAD + PAST PARTICIPLE.
Before that past moment, as a question:: Antes de ese momento pasado, en pregunta: HAD + you + EVER + PAST PARTICIPLE?
It happened before I got back: HAD + PAS: Pasó antes de que yo volviera: HAD + PAST PARTICIPLE. EAT → EATEN.
Reported speech moves back: \"I've lost: En estilo indirecto el tiempo retrocede: "I've lost them" → "he said he HAD LOST them".
HAD + LOCKED: done before we found the h: HAD + LOCKED: hecho antes de que encontráramos el refugio. Past perfect.
\"It was the first time\" looks back fro: "It was the first time" mira atrás desde un momento pasado: HAD + PAST PARTICIPLE.
Nothing up to that past moment: HADN'T +: Nada hasta ese momento pasado: HADN'T + PAST PARTICIPLE.
A past that did not happen: IF + HAD + P: Un pasado que no ocurrió: IF + HAD + PAST PARTICIPLE.
By the time we got the stove going, the: Para cuando conseguimos encender el hornillo, el sol ya se **había puesto**.
We **had been shivering** outside for an: **Llevábamos** una hora **temblando** fuera cuando Tensing por fin consiguió abrir la puerta del refugio.
And it **had been snowing** all day. My: Y **había estado nevando** todo el día. ¡Tenía la barba congelada!
How long something had been going on bef: Cuánto tiempo llevaba pasando algo antes de un momento pasado, o la actividad que explica un estado pasado: HAD BEEN + VERB-ING.
A long activity behind a past state: HAD: Una actividad larga que explica un estado pasado: HAD BEEN + VERB-ING.
How long, up to a past moment: HAD + you: Cuánto tiempo, hasta un momento pasado: HAD + you + BEEN + VERB-ING?
\"for two days\" up to a past moment: HA: "for two days" hasta un momento pasado: HAD BEEN + SITTING.
The activity behind what she found: HAD: La actividad que explica lo que encontró: HAD BEEN + VERB-ING.
HAD BEEN + STARING: a long activity befo: HAD BEEN + STARING: una actividad larga antes de un momento pasado. Past perfect continuous.
\"four cups\" is a number, a result: HAD: "four cups" es una cantidad, un resultado: HAD + PAST PARTICIPLE (campamento diez). DRINK → DRUNK.
\"for eleven hours\" up to a past moment: "for eleven hours" hasta un momento pasado: HAD BEEN + FALLING.
Negative, up to a past moment: HADN'T +: En negativa, hasta un momento pasado: HADN'T + BEEN + VERB-ING.
We **had been dreaming** about that hut: **Llevábamos** días **soñando** con ese refugio. Era perfecto.
By ten the day after tomorrow, we**'ll h: Para pasado mañana a las diez ya **habremos llegado** a la cima.
And by two we **will have started** down: Y para las dos ya **habremos empezado** a bajar. La montaña no espera.
Finished before a time in the future, or: Terminado antes de un momento futuro, o una suposición segura sobre ahora: WILL HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE. Busca BY. Después de BY THE TIME: el presente.
Not done by a future time: WON'T HAVE +: Algo que no estará hecho para un momento futuro: WON'T HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE.
\"By the time you get back\" = done befo: "By the time you get back" = hecho antes de ese momento: WILL HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE.
A total reached by a future time: WILL H: Un total alcanzado para un momento futuro: WILL HAVE + WALKED.
After BY THE TIME, the future takes the: Después de BY THE TIME, el futuro va en presente: you PACK, no you WILL PACK.
HAD + CLIMBED with \"By 1998\": done bef: HAD + CLIMBED con "By 1998": hecho antes de un momento pasado. Past perfect, no el campamento doce.
A confident guess about now: WILL HAVE +: Una suposición segura sobre ahora: WILL HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE, con "by now".
\"by the time you read this\" = done bef: "by the time you read this" = hecho antes de ese momento: WILL + ALREADY + HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE. FLY → FLOWN.
A question about a future deadline: WILL: Una pregunta sobre un plazo futuro: WILL + sujeto + HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE?
By sunset tomorrow we **will have reache: Para mañana al atardecer ya **habremos llegado** al campamento trece. Descansad bien.
By the time we reach the top, we**'ll ha: Cuando lleguemos a la cima, **llevaremos** casi dos semanas **viviendo** en tiendas.
Last camp. By ten tomorrow we**'ll have: Último campamento. Mañana a las diez **llevaremos** seis horas **caminando**, así que cenad bien esta noche.
How long it will have gone on by a futur: Cuánto tiempo habrá durado algo para un momento futuro: WILL HAVE BEEN + VERB-ING. Necesita una duración.
How long, up to a future point: WILL + w: Cuánto tiempo, hasta un momento futuro: WILL + we + HAVE BEEN + VERB-ING?
\"for forty years\" up to a future point: "for forty years" hasta un momento futuro: WILL HAVE BEEN + VERB-ING.
\"for three hours\" up to a future point: "for three hours" hasta un momento futuro: WILL HAVE BEEN + EATING.
\"four times\" is a number, a result: WI: "four times" es una cantidad, un resultado: WILL HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE (campamento doce).
WILL HAVE + REACHED: done by a future ti: WILL HAVE + REACHED: hecho para un momento futuro, sin duración. Future perfect, no el campamento trece.
KNOW is a state verb: WILL HAVE + KNOWN,: KNOW es un verbo de estado: WILL HAVE + KNOWN, nunca BEEN KNOWING.
\"for two weeks\" up to a future point:: "for two weeks" hasta un momento futuro: WILL HAVE BEEN + WEARING.
Not long, up to a future moment: WON'T H: Poco tiempo, hasta un momento futuro: WON'T HAVE BEEN + VERB-ING.
Sleep now. By sunrise tomorrow we**'ll h: A dormir. Mañana al amanecer **llevaremos** dos horas **caminando**.
The summit push. You**'ve met** every te: El ataque a la cumbre. **Has conocido** todos los tiempos verbales en la subida. Ahora llegan todos a la vez.
Read the whole line before you answer: t: Lee la frase entera antes de responder: las palabras de tiempo (NOW, SINCE, BY, WHEN) deciden el tiempo verbal.
\"Listen!\" = it is happening now: IS +: "Listen!" = está pasando ahora: IS + VERB-ING. Campamento uno.
A regular fact, and the sun is \"it\": V: Un hecho regular, y el sol es "it": VERB + -S. Campamento dos.
\"in 1987\" = a finished, stated time: P: "in 1987" = un tiempo terminado y especificado: PAST FORM. Campamento tres.
\"in my life\", up to now: HAVE + NEVER: "in my life", hasta ahora: HAVE + NEVER + PAST PARTICIPLE. Campamento cuatro.
You can see it coming: IS + GOING TO + B: Lo ves venir: IS + GOING TO + BASE VERB. Campamento cinco.
In the middle of lunch when the hail cam: En plena comida cuando llegó el granizo: WAS + VERB-ING. Campamento seis.
WILL + DROP after \"I think\": just what: WILL + DROP después de "I think": simplemente lo que crees que pasará. Campamento siete.
\"since four this morning\", up to now:: "since four this morning", hasta ahora: HAVE BEEN + VERB-ING. Campamento ocho.
In the middle of it at a future time: WI: En plena acción en un momento futuro: WILL BE + VERB-ING. Campamento nueve.
Earlier than \"we reached\": HAD + ALREA: Antes que "we reached": HAD + ALREADY + PAST PARTICIPLE. Campamento diez.
A long activity behind a past state: HAD: Una actividad larga que explica un estado pasado: HAD BEEN + VERB-ING. Campamento once.
Done before you are back: WILL HAVE + PA: Hecho antes de que vuelvas: WILL HAVE + PAST PARTICIPLE. Campamento doce.
\"for thirteen whole days\" up to a futu: "for thirteen whole days" hasta un momento futuro: WILL HAVE BEEN + VERB-ING. Campamento trece.
We**'ve made** it. Look down: every camp: Lo **hemos conseguido**. Mirad abajo: todos los campamentos quedan atrás.
I**'ve never felt** so tired, or so happ: **Nunca me he sentido** tan cansado, ni tan feliz.
Nearly forty years, and the view still *: Casi cuarenta años, y la vista todavía me **quita** el aliento.
Congratulations, everyone! Bad news, tho: ¡Enhorabuena a todos! Pero hay una mala noticia: Momo se **ha comido** vuestra tarta. Cambio.
